full_judgment: 2. The short facts that the opposite party filed a Title Suit being No. 50 of 1968 before the learned Subordinate Judge under section 9 Of the Specific Relief Act which was contested by the petitioner No.1. The suit, however, was decree on 26.2.71 and there was an order for restoration of possession to the plaintiff after evicting the defendant or any person claiming through him. This decree was put into execution by the opposite party, and an order was passed on 25.5.71 for issuance of writ of possession by breaking open the lock, if necessary, as prayed for, and 24.6.71 was fixed for return and orders On 24.6.71 it has been noted by the learned Subordinate judge that possession has been duly delivered to the decree-holder on 28.5.71 and no objection had been raised. The decree-holder was directed to take further steps in the matter. On 4.4.72, the decree-holder opposite party filed an application praying tor vacating the orders dated 24.6.71 and 6.7.71 on the ground stated in the said application.
